regime_context: The absolute-trend gate validates on this market (gate_helps true), so the discipline's protection leg is meaningful even though cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing has no edge. Leadership is concentrated in Base Metals & Copper (score 1.463, durability 0.43, mean-revert tag) with Oil & Gas a close challenger (1.403, durability 0.62); breadth of rotation is narrowing (44% eligible), absorption is low (0.31), and no single narrative dominates.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Technology (rank 6, crowded=true, z 1.23) can hold its eligible status without bleeding lower relative to the TSX despite the crowding flag — I am looking for XIT.TO to trade above its own trailing trend AND for rank to improve into the top 5 or for the crowding z to normalize below ~1.0 on no new downside before I'd consider it anything more than a crowding cap. Retire the watch if XIT.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% or more.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas has the strongest durability_bar (0.62) among eligible leaders, the highest breadth (0.5), and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Unlike Base Metals (mean-revert, breadth 0.333, durability 0.43) or Gold (breadth 0.067), its mixed hurst and 50% breadth suggest the theme has internal participation, not a one-name spike. Momentum rank is just a focus lens, not an edge, but the trend-gate protects against the shake-outs this market historically suffers.
theses.dissent: WTI/energy complex rides the same macro risk as the broader TSX; if the global growth narrative softens, both Base Metals and Oil & Gas rotate down together and the absolute-trend gate does nothing to preserve relative performance.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Leading rank (1.463) and eligible under the trend gate, with the rotation leader label and no crowding (z 0.67, crowded false). Supported by the absolute-trend discipline as a trend-following, vol-aware allocation. But breadth is only 0.333 and the hurst tag is mean-revert, so this is a fragile leadership concentrated in few names.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst with 33% breadth means the leadership rests on a thin base; a copper price pullback would hit the theme disproportionately, and the durability bar (0.43) is below Oil & Gas.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO falls 5% from its 5-day high while the S&P/TSX is flat or up

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Eligible (rank 3, score 1.085) with no crowding, making it a candidate under the trend-gate discipline. But breadth is a near-zero 0.067 — the leadership is essentially a single name or two moving — and durability is only 0.41, so the theme is fragile and the lean is held at low conviction.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.067 means the score is driven by one or two miners; this is a single-stock proxy disguised as a theme and offers no diversified trend exposure.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms XEG.TO by 5% before the check-by date
